title: Trade Tier
description: Defines a tier of trades that becomes available as a villager levels up.

total_exp_required.title: Total Experience Required
total_exp_required.description: The total experience points required for this tier to unlock. For novice (tier 1), this is typically 0. Higher tiers require more XP (e.g., 10, 70, 150, 250).

groups.title: Trade Groups
groups.description:
Array of trade groups available at this tier. Each group can randomly select one or more trades to offer.

Properties:
• num_to_select (int) = 1
• trades

trades.title: Trades (Direct)
trades.description:
Array of trades directly in this tier, without grouping. Alternative to using groups.

Properties:
• wants
• gives
• trader_exp (int) = 1
• max_uses (int) = 12
• reward_exp (boolean) = true

trade_tradeitem_quantity.title: Trade Item Quantity
trade_tradeitem_quantity.description: Defines a random quantity range for a trade item.

min.title: Minimum
min.description: Minimum number of items for this trade.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Maximum number of items for this trade.

trade_tradeitem.title: Trade Item
trade_tradeitem.description: Defines an item used in a trade, either as input (wants) or output (gives).

item.title: Item
item.description: The item identifier, e.g., 'minecraft:emerald' or 'minecraft:coal'. Can include data value suffix like 'minecraft:coal:0'.

defaultSnippets.label: Trade Item Quantity (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Defines a random quantity range for a trade item.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of this item involved in the trade. Can be a fixed number or an object with min/max for random quantity.

defaultSnippets.label: Trade Item Quantity (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Defines a random quantity range for a trade item.

price_multiplier.title: Price Multiplier
price_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to price increases when supply/demand changes. Higher values mean prices fluctuate more. Typical value is 0.05.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional filters that must pass for this item to be included in the trade.

functions.title: Functions
functions.description:
[DEPRECATED] Array of functions to apply to the trade item, such as enchantments. This property was deprecated and removed in newer versions of trade tables.

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.19.0*

choice.title: Choice
choice.description:
[DEPRECATED] Alternative items that can be traded. This property was deprecated and removed in newer versions of trade tables.

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.19.0*

trade_tradesingle.title: Trade
trade_tradesingle.description: Defines a single trade offered by a villager or wandering trader.

wants.title: Wants
wants.description:
Array of items the villager wants to receive from the player in exchange. Usually 1-2 items.

Properties:
• item (string)
• quantity (int) = 1
• price_multiplier (float) = 0.05
• filters (object)
• functions
• choice

gives.title: Gives
gives.description:
Array of items the villager gives to the player in exchange. Usually 1 item.

Properties:
• item (string)
• quantity (int) = 1
• price_multiplier (float) = 0.05
• filters (object)
• functions
• choice

trader_exp.title: Trader Experience
trader_exp.description: Amount of experience the villager gains when this trade is used. Contributes to villager leveling up.

max_uses.title: Maximum Uses
max_uses.description: Maximum number of times this trade can be used before it becomes locked. Trade refreshes when villager restocks at workstation.

reward_exp.title: Reward Experience
reward_exp.description: Whether the player receives experience orbs when completing this trade.

trade_tradegroup.title: Trade Group
trade_tradegroup.description: A group of trades from which one or more can be randomly selected for a villager to offer.

num_to_select.title: Number to Select
num_to_select.description: The number of trades to randomly select from this group to offer to the player. Typically 1-2.

trades.title: Trades
trades.description:
Array of possible trades in this group. The specified number will be randomly chosen.

Properties:
• wants
• gives
• trader_exp (int) = 1
• max_uses (int) = 12
• reward_exp (boolean) = true
